title: Redirects
intro: Send visitors and search engines from old addresses to new ones.
add.title: Add redirect
field.from_help: A path on this site, e.g. /old-page. Matching is exact and case-sensitive.
field.to_help: A path on this site or a full https:// address.
search.label: Search redirects
import.title: Import from CSV
import.help: One redirect per line: from,to,status (status is optional and defaults to 301). Existing paths are updated.
import.error_file: Choose a CSV file (up to 5 MB).
import.error_syntax: Could not read this line as CSV
import.error_duplicate: This path appears more than once in the file
import.error_too_many: Too many lines; the rest was skipped
error.from_reserved: This path belongs to GoRun (admin, API, media, checkout, account…) and cannot be redirected
error.from_taken: A redirect for this path already exists
error.to_invalid: Enter a path starting with / or a full http(s) address
error.loop: A redirect cannot point to itself
